conviction_note: The quarter is pre-released, the guide is pre-changed and the dividend is pre-announced, all by MAR ad-hocs on 4 and 6 November (stock +1.0%, -3.7%, +2.6% on those days). The release adds Q3 detail, cash and net cash and call commentary, with no sign I can source, so abs_move sits at the pre-released base of about 3% and p_up at 50. The findings net to 0.0, and the two measurements agree.

already_public.what: Preliminary unaudited 9M 2026: Adjusted EBITDA EUR 1,024m (PY 641m), Adjusted Net Income EUR 579m (PY 268m). 2026 Adjusted Net Income guide raised to EUR 550-650m (from 500-600m); Adjusted EBITDA guide unchanged at EUR 1,100-1,300m. MAR Art. 17 ad-hoc, 13:57 CET
Dividend policy (EUR 300m base, 7% CAGR) and an intended FY2026 dividend of EUR 321m / EUR 0.77 per share. MAR ad-hoc, 09:58 CET
Uniper won nothing in the first round of the German power-plant capacity auction (results published 3 Nov). The Bundesnetzagentur is to announce the second bid date on 10 Nov

Reprivatisation: the government is running a dual-track M&A / re-IPO process for up to 74.12%. Non-binding bids were due 21 Sep; valuation 'in Finanzkreisen' is EUR 13.5bn against a EUR 18.3bn market cap at 1% free float

new_in_release.expect: Q3 standalone and segment detail (Flexible Generation, Green Generation, Greener Commodities). The headline 9M is already out, so expect it in line with the ad-hoc (EUR 1,024m / 579m)

No change expected: the ad-hoc six days earlier already set it, and a further change would itself have required an ad-hoc. One open point is how management explains the implied Q4 (Adj. EBITDA EUR 76-276m against EUR 456m in Q4 2025). Direction unknown
Operating cash flow, economic net cash (EUR 2.823bn at FY2025 after the EUR 2.551bn repayment to the government). Unknown, and new to the market
Already announced 6 Nov. Nothing new expected

Call commentary on reprivatisation (the CEO has deflected all such questions to the government), the second capacity-auction round and data-centre projects. Strategy and 2027+ targets are signposted for the 16 Nov CMD, which is outside the window

bar: Company's own preliminary 9M figures and the raised guide in the 4 Nov 2026 ad-hoc (https://www.eqs-news.com/news/ad-hoc/uniper-se-raises-2026-adjusted-net-income-outlook/0efb9d9b-7a33-48a4-86f8-8d76de91ca3b_en). No sell-side consensus EPS could be sourced: the baseline's Yahoo consensus is empty, and analyst counts conflict (aktien.guide 12 ratings, 0 buy / 5 hold / 7 sell, average target EUR 35.70; investing.com 3 analysts, EUR 34.67). So every finding is capped small.
session_check: baseline bmo, not confirmed by an issuer timestamp for 10 Nov. The issuer's EQS notice of 2 Nov 2026 sets the 9M statement for 10 November 2026 (https://www.eqs-news.com/news/advance-financial-reports/uniper-se-preliminary-announcement-of-the-publication-of-quarterly-reports-and-quarterly-interim-statements/eebcdf0b-5c44-48dc-91f6-d0dfd181fef7_en), and the 4 Nov ad-hoc repeats the date. Prior results days moved on the release day itself, and cash.ch reported the H1 numbers at 11:55 on 11 Aug 2026 (https://www.cash.ch/news/uniper-wird-zuversichtlicher-fur-2026-rechenzentren-plane-reifen-960093). That is consistent with a pre-open release, but no release time was found (uniper.energy is behind Cloudflare and refused both tools).
positioning_check: Bundesanzeiger register read 2026-11-06. No disclosed net short at or above 0.5% (anchor_covered false; a truncated zero, not a measurement). Change 0.0 means not known. With about 1% free float held outside the government, shorting is structurally negligible. The 'priced lean' is effectively the run-up (-5.8% over 20d, -6.0% over 60d).

findings.finding: The unchanged EUR 1.1-1.3bn Adj. EBITDA guide implies a Q4 2026 of EUR 76-276m against EUR 456m in Q4 2025 (FY2025 1,097 minus 9M 641). The raised Adj. NI guide implies Q4 of EUR -29m to +71m against +276m. The 9M release and call are where management either explains a real Q4 headwind (front-loaded gas-trading gains, hedging) or signals conservatism ahead of the CMD and IPO.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The guide change itself has already traded: +1.02% on 4 Nov (ad-hoc at 13:57), then -3.70% on 5 Nov with no other identified cause (trading-treff: 'kein Auslöser ableitbar'). Results days without a pre-release moved +7.15% (FY, 11 Mar 2026), -1.59% (Q1, 12 May 2026) and +6.85% (H1, 11 Aug 2026). The last pre-released 9M (6 Nov 2025) moved -1.2%.
findings.original_quote: Uniper erhöht die Prognose für das Adjusted Net Income für das Jahr 2026 um 50 Mio. EUR auf 550 bis 650 Mio. € gegenüber bislang 500–600 Mio. EUR. Die Prognose für das Adjusted EBITDA bleibt unverändert bestehen zwischen 1.100-1.300 Mio. EUR. (Uniper raises its 2026 Adjusted Net Income outlook by EUR 50m to EUR 550-650m from EUR 500-600m; the Adjusted EBITDA outlook stays unchanged at EUR 1,100-1,300m.)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the ad-hoc was public six days before the print and the stock has already reacted twice. What is not priced is management's explanation of the implied Q4 trough. The Q4 2025 comparison comes from FY2025 press-release arithmetic (https://www.uniper.energy/news/uniper-achieves-financial-targets-for-fiscal-year-2025-and-proposes-dividend-payment-of-072-per-share, via search snippet; the site refused direct fetch). If the market had priced a sandbag, the stock would not have given back 3.7% the day after a guide raise.
findings.independence: The Q1 commentary that Q1 would deliver about 40% of the FY EBITDA guide (search snippet on the FY2025 release) points to a front-loaded year, which argues for a real Q4 trough rather than a sandbag. So the independent evidence cuts toward 0, not toward a positive.

findings.finding: Uniper won nothing in the first round of the German Kraftwerksstrategie capacity auction (results 3 Nov), despite the CEO saying he firmly expected an award. The Bundesnetzagentur is due to set the second bid date on 10 Nov, the print day, so the call will likely be asked about Scholven/Staudinger and the capex reallocation.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance on this line. The week of the auction result was +0.80% (3 Nov), +1.02% (4 Nov) and -3.70% (5 Nov), so it is not cleanly separable from the guidance ad-hoc.
findings.original_quote: Allerdings hatte Uniper erst in dieser Woche einen Dämpfer erfahren, kam der Versorger bei der Vergabe zum Bau neuer Kraftwerkskapazitäten in der ersten Auktionsrunde doch nicht zum Zug. (Uniper suffered a setback only this week: the utility came away empty-handed in the first auction round for new power-plant capacity.)
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: it is public, in the domestic press since 3-6 Nov, and inside the 5 Nov drawdown. What remains is any capex or target revision management attaches to it on the call. More likely that is kept for the 16 Nov CMD, outside the window.
findings.independence: Uniper's CEO said beforehand he expected an award (https://www.boersen-zeitung.de/unternehmen-branchen/uniper-rechnet-fest-mit-zuschlag-fuer-gaskraftwerke, search result, not fetched). The search summary of the auction list (ingenieur.de) says Uniper is not among the 11 winners. Same fact, different outlet.

findings.finding: New medium-term dividend policy (EUR 300m base, 7% CAGR) with an intended FY2026 dividend of EUR 0.77/share (EUR 321m), about a 1.8% yield at EUR 43, explicitly positioned by Börsen-Zeitung as re-IPO preparation.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: +2.56% on 6 Nov, the day of the ad-hoc (09:58 CET). Before that, the first post-rescue dividend proposal at the FY2025 results (11 Mar 2026) came on a +7.15% day.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: it is an ad-hoc that traded +2.56% on the day. It is filed so that the set is complete. The 9M release will only repeat it.
findings.independence: Börsen-Zeitung, 6 Nov (https://www.boersen-zeitung.de/unternehmen-branchen/uniper-verspricht-wachsende-dividenden): 'Gemäß der neuen Ausschüttungsstrategie wird den Aktionären ... eine Dividende von 0,77 Euro je Aktie ... vorgeschlagen.'

outside_window.finding: Capital Markets Day in London (strategy update, growth ambitions; reported as the first sounding of re-IPO investors; materials 09:00 CET). This is where 2027+ targets and the IPO equity story land.

Government's choice between a block sale (bidders reported: Equinor, Brookfield/CPPIB, Apollo, KKR/RWE, EPH, Centrica) and a re-IPO targeted for early 2027. The reported private-market value (EUR 13.5bn) sits about 25% below the listed market cap (EUR 18.3bn at 1% float), so a placement price is the overhang. No decision is dated inside the window.

baseline_tension: The findings are flat and the lean is flat. Priced lean +0.29 comes entirely from the -5.8% 20-day run-up; there is no short anchor. Nothing found cuts against either.
language_note: The German original of the 4 Nov ad-hoc ('Erhöht Prognose für das Adjusted Net Income 2026') is identical in substance to the English one; nothing extra.

Börsen-Zeitung (German only) carried three things the English search results did not. (1) Uniper came away empty in the first capacity-auction round, in the same week as the ad-hocs. (2) Uniper is preparing internally to be IPO-ready at the start of 2027, and the 16 Nov CMD is the first investor sounding. (3) The bidder list now includes Centrica.

Börsen-Zeitung's September process-letter story (German) carried the EUR 13.5bn 'Finanzkreise' valuation against the EUR 18.3bn market cap, and the works council's opposition to a full takeover. English coverage repeated the bidder names but not the valuation gap.
lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the implied-Q4 guidance finding went from +0.3 to +0.1, because the guide itself was set by the 4 Nov ad-hoc and only the explanation is new.
Same rule: the capacity-auction finding went from -0.2 to -0.1, because it has been public since 3-6 Nov and sits inside the 5 Nov drawdown.

'A German ad-hoc before the print may have pre-released the number' confirmed that abs_move belongs at the pre-released base of about 3% rather than the 9% guidance-change base. Left unchanged at 3.0.
'In a live bid, results are noise': the reprivatisation process is the bigger driver, but there is no public offer and nothing dated in the window, so it stays in outside_window. p_up held at 50.
Session rule: the session_check does not open with bmo/amc, because no issuer timestamp was found.
